body.prompt: Create only a clean full-bleed environment background for the supplied Russian fairy-tale guild screen. Match its painterly dusk city: dark ornate Russian wooden architecture and towers, golden onion domes on the right, twilight warm peach and violet clouds behind the middle skyline, navy star-speckled sky, pale birch trunks framing far left and right edges, sparse gold foliage. Preserve the visible scenery style, colors and building scale as closely as possible. Reconstruct scenery hidden by the interface. Keep the center and bottom dark navy and low contrast for separate opaque UI. Portrait orientation. Remove EVERY interface element: no header, portraits, people, guild banner, eagle, crest, medals, panels, frames, cards, buttons, chests, icons, text, letters, numerals or watermarks. This is only a clean environment, never a whole game screen.
